summary: Backend pytest suite for Torah Chanting Aid: 15/15 tests passed against external preview URL. Validated health, index build (~5846 verses), books, parshiyot (54), chapter retrieval w/ cantillation, locate (full snippet, 3-word snippet, hint_book, <4 chars 400), lines (active+prev+next w/ te'amim, 404), sessions CRUD (UUID, no ObjectId), calibration save+fetch, and CORS.

minor.issue: Returns empty {} on missing session instead of 404 — minor REST hygiene issue, but matches current spec.
When no match (best_score < 0.2) returns null body with 200; clients must handle null. Could be 404 instead.

critical_code_review_comments: estimate_aliyah double-iterates _unvocalized_index (O(N) twice per call) and computes 'total' incorrectly (it adds to existing count) — works because of >> verses but math is misleading. Acceptable as a heuristic but worth a refactor.
/api/calibration/{id} returns {} instead of 404 when no calibration exists; consider HTTP 404 for consistency.
/api/torah/locate returns null body with 200 when no match — clients may break on null parsing; consider 404 or a structured {found: false}.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec (browsers ignore credentials with wildcard). OK for this app since no auth/cookies.
server.py is ~600 lines — borderline; future split into routers/torah.py, routers/sessions.py recommended.
build_index_for_book silently returns on Sefaria failure; first /api/index/build could succeed-with-zero-verses if Sefaria is down. Consider raising HTTPException so health endpoint reflects reality.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed sessions and calibrations during runs (not cleaned up; small footprint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Index build is cached in-memory; first /api/index/build hits Sefaria (~5846 verses) and takes time. Subsequent calls are instant. ObjectId hygiene verified across sessions/calibration. Tests pass against the public preview URL. If Sefaria is rate-limited, the index endpoint may degrade silently — reproduce by checking /api/health indexed_verses count.
